# MeetVap

MeetVap is an open-source, full-stack video conferencing and messaging application. 

## Repository Structure
- `/server`: The Express.js backend and LiveKit integrations.
- `/meet` & `/web`: The frontend web applications.
- `/src/screens`: The React Native mobile application screens.
- `/admin`: The custom admin dashboard.

## Links
- GitHub: https://github.com/RzaAsadov/MeetVap
